scope: Corollary 2.6 (Finite interval form with prescribed divisibility) of the manuscript “Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers” (preprints/Monochromatic-finite-sums-and-products-in-the-positive-integers-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 164 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab835f6a98c10d6d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix integers r, m, q ≥ 1 and real numbers R ≥ 2, D ≥ 1. There exists N such that every r-coloring of [N] admits A = {a1 < · · · < am} ⊂ qN with FS(A) ∪ FP(A) ⊆ [N] monochromatic and a1 > R, ad > R ⎛ ⎝ ∑︂ k<d ak + ∏︂ k<d ak ⎞ ⎠ D (2 ≤ d ≤ m). The subset sums and products have the distinctness properties of Corollary 1.2.
